questions.question: Day 14 Vocabulary (Performance Reviews & Goals (Phase 2)): What is the exact practical meaning of the phrase 'freshen up'?

options.a: To clean or inspect a physical room thoroughly.
options.b: To perform a daily task hastily without preparation.
options.c: Wash hands and face to relax after travel.
options.d: To postpone or cancel an activity indefinitely.

questions.explanation:
Correct: Option C
'freshen up' means: wash hands and face to relax after travel. Example: "Let me freshen up after returning home."

questions.question:
Day 14 Translation Scenario 1 (Performance Reviews & Goals (Phase 2)):

Telugu: "సాయంత్రం మా ఇంటికి రండి, టీ తాగుదాం."
(Literal attempt: "Evening my house come, tea drink.")

options.a: Evening my house come, tea drink.
options.b: Literal Indian English phrasing without modal polite verbs.
options.c: I am needing to evening my house come, tea drink.
options.d: Please drop by our home this evening; we can have tea together.

questions.explanation:
Correct: Option D
Natural Version: "Please drop by our home this evening; we can have tea together."

Use 'drop by our home' for informal invitations.
